page: Microsoft Azure M416-208s_v2 is a memory-optimized server from the MSv2 family, powered by Intel Xeon 8280L processors. It features an x86_64 architecture with 208 vCPUs mapped to 104 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with a massive 5700.0 GB of system memory, translating to 27.4 GB of RAM per core. It also includes 8389 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, operating under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance profile. While single-core performance is relatively weak, scoring in the bottom 25% for stress-ng single-core and average for Geekbench single-core, multi-core capabilities are exceptional. The server achieves top-tier status in stress-ng multi-core performance, Passmark CPU tests, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory bandwidth is also highly optimized, reaching top-tier read and write speeds, such as 10446.46 GB/sec cached read. Redis SET operations perform exceptionally well, registering 162.62 million operations per second.

The qualitative cost efficiency of this server lies in its extreme resource density, combining massive memory capacity with high multi-threaded compute power. However, workloads requiring high single-threaded performance or GPU acceleration are not suitable, as the server lacks GPUs and exhibits lower single-core benchmark results. It is highly optimized for large-scale in-memory databases, massive data warehousing, enterprise-grade virtualization, and heavy multi-threaded data processing tasks.
description: The Microsoft Azure M416-208s_v2 is a high-density, memory-optimized server from the MSv2 family. Powered by Intel Xeon 8280L processors on an x86_64 architecture, it delivers 208 dedicated vCPUs at 2.7 GHz, paired with an extensive 5700.0 GB of RAM and 8389 GB of local storage. Running on Microsoft Hyper-V, the server is Premium Storage capable. While single-core benchmarks are modest, its multi-threaded performance is top-tier, as demonstrated by exceptional stress-ng multi-core, Passmark CPU, and memory bandwidth results. It also excels in Redis SET operations, achieving 162.62 million operations per second. This hardware profile is designed for memory-intensive workloads, including large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise data warehousing, and heavy multi-threaded processing, where massive memory capacity and high concurrent throughput are critical.
